info.name: Auth0 Authentication actions organizations API
organizations
Get Organizations

params.name: page
params.description: Page index of the results to return. First page is 0.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 50.

params.name: include_totals
params.description: Return results inside an object that contains the total result count (true) or as a direct array of results (false, default).

params.name: from
params.description: Optional Id from which to start selection.

params.name: take
params.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 50.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort by. Use field:order where order is 1 for ascending and -1 for descending. e.g. created_at:1. We currently support sorting by the following fields: name, display_name and created_at.

items.docs:
Retrieve detailed list of all Organizations available in your tenant. For more information, see Auth0 Organizations. This endpoint supports two types of pagination:
  • Offset pagination
  • Checkpoint pagination
Checkpoint pagination must be used if you need to retrieve more than 1000 organizations.

Checkpoint Pagination

To search by checkpoint, use the following parameters:
  • from: Optional id from which to start selection.
  • t

  • Member roles are not sent by default. Use fields=roles to retrieve the roles assig

items.docs: Set one or more existing users as members of a specific Organization. To add a user to an Organization through this action, the user must already exist in your tenant. If a user does not yet exist, you can invite them to create an account, manually create them through the Auth0 Dashboard, or use the Management API.

info.name: Get User Roles Assigned to an Organization Member

params.name: id
params.description: Organization identifier.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the user to associate roles with.

params.name: page
params.description: Page index of the results to return. First page is 0.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 50.

params.name: include_totals
params.description: Return results inside an object that contains the total result count (true) or as a direct array of results (false, default).

items.docs:
Retrieve detailed list of roles assigned to a given user within the context of a specific Organization. 

Users can be members of multiple Organizations with unique roles assigned for each membership. This action only returns the roles associated with the specified Organization; any roles assigned to the user within other Organizations are not included.

info.name: Assign User Roles to an Organization Member

params.name: id
params.description: Organization identifier.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the user to associate roles with.

items.docs: Assign one or more roles to a user to determine their access for a specific Organization. Users can be members of multiple Organizations with unique roles assigned for each membership. This action assigns roles to a user only for the specified Organization. Roles cannot be assigned to a user across multiple Organizations in the same call.

info.name: Delete User Roles from an Organization Member

params.name: id
params.description: Organization identifier.

params.name: user_id
params.description: User ID of the organization member to remove roles from.

items.docs: Remove one or more Organization-specific roles from a given user. Users can be members of multiple Organizations with unique roles assigned for each membership. This action removes roles from a user in relation to the specified Organization. Roles assigned to the user within a different Organization cannot be managed in the same call.
